inputs.original_text: Listen, this whole US-Israel-Iran thing is clearly staged by the real powers behind the scenes. The US floats a 15-point ceasefire plan through Pakistan like it's some sincere offer, but it's obvious bait to keep the pressure on. Iran comes back with their five conditions for stopping the aggression, getting compensation, and securing sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz, yet the elites are already twisting it to make Iran look unreasonable. Israel doesn't even bother hiding it—they're straight-up skeptical and pushing their pre-emptive strike rights, which shows the whole narrative is coordinated to justify whatever escalation the hidden hands want next. None of this is about ending conflict; it's manipulation from the top to control the region and the story.
